detail.longDescription: We were watching SBS last night and an advert for Hostinger came on. My wife looked at me and I gave them a 'wait for it' look. After a few seconds the "tell our AI agent what you want and it will build it in minutes" sell came up and they said "ah". Then the price "from $2.99 per month". Their mouth fell open and I said how can anyone compete with that? These guys are spending a lot of money pushing cheap throw-it-together AI website builders. I know, don't compete with it, they're not my customers, etc, but it still stings. I've never been one to sell myself, and justifying my existence is hard to do. # webdev # ai # noai # website # hostinger # aiwebdevelopment # aislop # webdesign # hosting
